% Grid dimensions
n_rows(N) :- N = #count{R : input(R, _, _)}.
n_cols(M) :- M = #count{C : input(_, C, _)}.
row(0..N-1) :- n_rows(N).
col(0..M-1) :- n_cols(M).

% Output cell definition
output_cell(R, C) :- row(R), col(C).

% Exactly one colour per cell
1 { output(R, C, Color) : color(Color) } 1 :- output_cell(R, C).

% Non‑zero cells keep their original colour
output(R, C, Color) :- input(R, C, Color), Color != 0.

% Neighbouring cells with colour 8 (orthogonal)
neighbor_up(R, C) :- input(R-1, C, 8), row(R), col(C).
neighbor_down(R, C) :- input(R+1, C, 8), row(R), col(C).
neighbor_left(R, C) :- input(R, C-1, 8), row(R), col(C).
neighbor_right(R, C) :- input(R, C+1, 8), row(R), col(C).

% Count of neighbours with colour 8 for each cell
neighbor8_count(R, C, Count) :- Count = #count{neighbor_up(R, C), neighbor_down(R, C), neighbor_left(R, C), neighbor_right(R, C)}.

% Zero cells: become 4 if exactly one neighbouring 8, else stay 0
output(R, C, 4) :- input(R, C, 0), neighbor8_count(R, C, Count), Count = 1.
output(R, C, 0) :- input(R, C, 0), neighbor8_count(R, C, Count), Count != 1.

% Grid dimensions
n_rows(N) :- N = #count{R : input(R, _, _)}.
n_cols(M) :- M = #count{C : input(_, C, _)}.
row(0..N-1) :- n_rows(N).
col(0..M-1) :- n_cols(M).

% Output cell definition
output_cell(R, C) :- row(R), col(C).

% Exactly one color per cell
1 { output(R, C, Color) : color(Color) } 1 :- output_cell(R, C).

% Non-zero cells keep their original color
output(R, C, Color) :- input(R, C, Color), Color != 0.

% Neighbors with color 8
neighbor_up(R, C) :- input(R-1, C, 8), row(R), col(C).
neighbor_down(R, C) :- input(R+1, C, 8), row(R), col(C).
neighbor_left(R, C) :- input(R, C-1, 8), row(R), col(C).
neighbor_right(R, C) :- input(R, C+1, 8), row(R), col(C).

% Count of neighbor 8s for a zero cell
neighbor8_count(R, C, Count) :- Count = #count{neighbor_up(R, C), neighbor_down(R, C), neighbor_left(R, C), neighbor_right(R, C)}.

% Zero cells: if exactly one neighbor 8, become 4, else stay 0
output(R, C, 4) :- input(R, C, 0), neighbor8_count(R, C, Count), Count = 1.
output(R, C, 0) :- input(R, C, 0), neighbor8_count(R, C, Count), Count != 1.

% 1. Grid dimensions
n_rows(N) :- N = #count{R : input(R, _, _)}.
n_cols(M) :- M = #count{C : input(_, C, _)}.

col(0..M-1) :- n_cols(M).

output_cell(R, C) :- row(R), col(C).

% 3. Exactly one color per cell
1 { output(R, C, Color) : color(Color) } 1 :- output_cell(R, C).

% 4. Non‑zero cells keep their original colour
output(R, C, Color) :- input(R, C, Color), Color != 0.

% 5. Neighbouring cells with colour 8 (orthogonal)
neighbor_up(R, C) :- input(R-1, C, 8), row(R), col(C).
neighbor_down(R, C) :- input(R+1, C, 8), row(R), col(C).
neighbor_left(R, C) :- input(R, C-1, 8), row(R), col(C).
neighbor_right(R, C) :- input(R, C+1, 8), row(R), col(C).

% 6. Count of neighbours with colour 8 for a zero cell
neighbor8_count(R, C, Count) :- Count = #count{neighbor_up(R, C), neighbor_down(R, C), neighbor_left(R, C), neighbor_right(R, C)}.

% 7. Zero cells: become 4 if exactly one neighbouring 8, otherwise stay 0
output(R, C, 4) :- input(R, C, 0), neighbor8_count(R, C, Count), Count = 1.
output(R, C, 0) :- input(R, C, 0), neighbor8_count(R, C, Count), Count != 1.
